summary: You take three quarters of SYMSYS 291 and one course of 3+ units in each of the formal, empirical, computational and philosophical areas, toward 45 units at the 100 level or above, at least 36 of them letter graded; every course is letter graded unless offered only S/NC. The 3.0 average in graded units, the research documents, the plan of study, the spread over three departments, the thesis and the development plan are checked by hand.
